content.text:
Recommend `<Metric variant="expanded" align="end" … />` for the third declared total.

Add optional `align?: "start" | "end"` to `Metric`, leaving it undefined by default so existing responsive alignment stays intact. Emit `data-align={align}` and place the shared alignment selectors after expanded-variant styles. Use `text-align: start/end`; keep the metric filling its grid cell so headings and values terminate at the section edge.

`DeclaredTotals` should choose the alignment explicitly for its third item. Apply it at every viewport: the request gives no desktop-only constraint, and adding a breakpoint-specific API would be unnecessary.

Alternative: make Metric inherit alignment and wrap the third item in an end-aligned feature container. This adds markup and changes the component’s default inheritance contract; it is less explicit and easier for unrelated ancestor styles to affect.

Document the optional prop in the component reference, add an expanded end-aligned gallery example, and test label/value alignment plus unchanged defaults. Verify MP and funder desktop right edges against the adjacent section, and retain exact-value keyboard scrolling on narrow screens. No financial parsing, totals, availability, or labels need changes.
